name: fight_act3_cazador
title: Act 3 boss: Cazador in his dungeon
about: Fight (family 1), a boss with a large crowd: the vampire lord Cazador Szarr and his werewolves, gur hunters and bats beneath Szarr Palace, about twenty-five enemies. claude-run-2 needed three tries (S074-S077); the winning one took 10 rounds and 1036 party HP.

start.needs_save: Act 3, the Lower City, Cazador's Dungeon below Szarr Palace, at the top of the stairs before the talk with Cazador that starts the fight (claude-run-2 S075-end, the start of its last tries): party level 11, companions (Gale, Karlach, Shadowheart), full HP. Avatar named Tav (a paladin, Oath of Devotion), Karmic Dice off, Balanced, out of combat with no dialogue open, saved as SCN-<name> (docs/SCENARIOS-AUTHORING.md).

note.where: Cazador's Dungeon below Szarr Palace, out of combat.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
